t: 英格兰农民革命的开始.
te: Beginning of the Peasants' Revolt in England.
dz: 英格兰农民革命的开始.
de: Beginning of the Peasants' Revolt in England.

t: 在英国,叛军聚集在伦敦外的布莱克希斯.
te: In England, rebels assemble at Blackheath, just outside London.
dz: 农民起义:在英国,叛军聚集在伦敦外的布莱克希斯.
de: Peasants' Revolt: In England, rebels assemble at Blackheath, just outside London.

t: 在英国,由瓦特·泰勒所领导的农民起义军来到一头,因为叛军放火烧了萨伏伊宫.
te: In England, the Peasants' Revolt, led by Wat Tyler, comes to a head, as rebels set fire to the Savoy Palace.
dz: 在英国,由瓦特·泰勒所领导的农民起义军来到一头,因为叛军放火烧了萨伏伊宫.
de: In England, the Peasants' Revolt, led by Wat Tyler, comes to a head, as rebels set fire to the Savoy Palace.

t: 英格兰的理查二世在"万里端"会见了农民起义的领导人. 伦敦塔被叛军冲入而无抵抗.
te: Richard II of England meets leaders of the Peasants' Revolt at Mile End. The Tower of London is stormed by rebels who e…
dz: 英格兰的理查二世在"万里端"会见了农民起义的领导人. 伦敦塔被叛军冲入而无抵抗.
de: Richard II of England meets leaders of the Peasants' Revolt at Mile End. The Tower of London is stormed by rebels who enter without resistance.

t: 约翰·鲍尔(John Ball)是"农民起义"的领袖,被绞死,被画出并被扎入阵营,当时英国国王…
te: John Ball, a leader in the Peasants' Revolt, is hanged, drawn and quartered in the presence of King Richard II of Engla…
dz: 约翰·鲍尔(John Ball)是"农民起义"的领袖,被绞死,被画出并被扎入阵营,当时英国国王理查德二世在场.
de: John Ball, a leader in the Peasants' Revolt, is hanged, drawn and quartered in the presence of King Richard II of England.
